newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says over 500 rebels killed or wounded.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says over 500 rebels killed or wounded.

text.p: Sri Lankan troops have killed or wounded more than 500 Tamil Tiger guerrillas in the first three days of a fresh offensive against the rebels' northern stronghold, a military spokesman said on Wednesday.
"The aim of this operation is to draw and kill as many terrorists as possible," Brigadier Sarath Munasinghe told a news conference.
"According to estimates made by ground troops over 75 terrorists were killed on Tuesday and more than 100 wounded," Munasinghe said.
The defence ministry said more than 330 were either killed or wounded on Sunday and Monday.
Separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels were resisting the army's latest push near the town of Kilinochchi, he said.
The rebels were using mainly mortars, he added.
